turns.text: morning. can you write a short friendly note for my parent group chat? it's the Flats Little Readers chat. theo is outgrowing size 1 diapers and i need size 2 soon, so i'm hoping someone has a spare size 2 sample or wants to swap sizes with me. i'd rather not do another diaper delivery if i can avoid it, since i only order diapers that way now, groceries i do in person at Ruiz Family Market on saturdays. keep it light, maybe one dad joke 🙃

Happy to help! Here's a draft:

---
Hi all! Quick diaper dilemma over here: my little guy is outgrowing size 1 faster than I can keep up with, and I'll need size 2 soon. Does anyone have a spare size 2 sample or a partial pack they'd like to swap for size 1? Happy to trade, and I'll even throw in a dad joke as a sweetener. (Why did the diaper get promoted? It was really on top of things.) Thanks, everyone!
---

Want it shorter, or should I mention a pickup spot? I can add a placeholder for that, like [your pickup location].
ha, love it. keep the joke. shorter please, and add that i'm happy to pick up wherever is easiest for them. also say thanks in advance

Here's the tighter version:

---
Hi all! Theo's outgrowing size 1 and I'll need size 2 soon. Anyone have a spare size 2 sample or want to swap sizes? Happy to pick up wherever is easiest for you. (Why did the diaper get promoted? It was really on top of things.) Thanks in advance!
---

If you'd like, I can make a second version that's a bit more casual for the chat.
this is perfect, thanks. scoreboard: dad 1, diaper shortage 0
Nice play! Hope someone comes through with a size 2 swap soon. Good luck with the post, and feel free to come back if you want help replying to anyone.
